_note: Food photos, one entry per picture: the /gallery page's 'On the menu' and 'Daily specials' sections, newest first. Images live in src/assets/photos/ as web copies: about 2000px, upright, camera and GPS data stripped. After adding one, run `npm run thumbs` for the gallery's small copy (without it the gallery shows the full photo). Full-size originals go in photos-originals/ at the repo root, which git ignores; never commit a camera original, because phone photos carry the GPS location. Photo post on the kitchen front page keeps the photos it takes in kitchen/photos/ on that PC, already re-drawn without GPS: copy one into src/assets/photos/ and give it an entry here. `item` is the dish EXACTLY as named in menu.json. `title` is what the gallery calls it. `alt` describes the picture for screen readers and is required. A daily special, which is not on the menu, sets `special: true` and `item: null` and is listed under Daily specials. `date` is when it was taken (YYYY-MM-DD) and sets the order. `variant`, `description` and `includesDrink` were for the Facebook dish posts (archived 2026-10-09 in archive/site-src/studio/fb-dish.njk) and stay so those can come back: `variant` is 'Chicken' or 'Burger' when the photo shows one version of a burger (menu.json's hot sandwiches note), else null; `description` is the post's words for a special, or for an item the menu gives none; `includesDrink: true` on a special made its post say a drink was included. Use only photos the cafe took or has permission to use, and no people: the staff do not want photos of themselves online.
